fixed_three_seed_forward_ensemble.development_interpretation: The forward-EMA ensemble is worse than the frozen direct-neural ensemble overall and at every horizon on corrected validation support. It therefore does not establish incremental value or SOTA.

control_interpretation: At matched seed 7 and supervised-update count, meaningful future pairing scored better than the temporally shuffled control and the frozen-random encoder control.

The variance floor raised every teacher dimension well above near-zero variance, but effective rank remained only 11.93 to 13.45 of 128 and predictor effective rank remained 6.82 to 7.33; the representation is not fully high-rank.
The single-seed controls are diagnostic and cannot replace the frozen three-seed family comparison.

independent_execution.artifact_hash_audit: All five slot JSON files, all saved checkpoints, final checkpoints and prediction artifacts matched their declared SHA-256 digests and every manifest slot was DONE.
independent_execution.cohort_reconstruction: Re-read TRAIN and validation through the frozen reader; reproduced 4,965 TRAIN rows, 4,923 forward pairs, 1,219 validation rows, the exact cohort and row digests, truth, masks and target source timestamps.
independent_execution.metric_recomputation: Recomputed each complete corrected eligible-date metric dictionary exactly from the saved prediction rows; recomputed the frozen three-seed forward and direct ensembles.
independent_execution.checkpoint_reload: Loaded every final state_dict strictly on CPU and reproduced every saved forecast with maximum absolute device difference 7.62939453125e-06 dB.
independent_execution.diagnostic_recomputation: Reloaded the final pretrain endpoint for trained slots and the frozen random endpoint, then reproduced every stored TRAIN-only representation diagnostic exactly.
independent_execution.nonconstant_predictions: All five prediction arrays were finite, monotone by quantile and nonconstant; standard deviations ranged from 3.0734 to 3.8875 dB.

limitations: This was a post-hoc TRAIN/validation extension designed after core development evidence.
The forward family used 1,500 supervised updates per seed versus 3,000 for the direct reference, so total updates are matched while labeled-update budgets differ.
Validation and single-deployment representation diagnostics do not establish external generalization, causal biology, calibrated absolute backscatter, or production value.
No model selection, calibration, retrospective TEST access, or final value-gate decision is approved by this outcome review.
